csv_row.description: This skill should be used when users ask about Chinese social security (社保) policies, contribution calculations, retirement benefits estimation, social security planning, or any province/city-specific social insurance regulations. Trigger phrases include: 社保、养老保险、医疗保险、失业保险、工伤、生育险、缴费基数、退休金、养老金、灵活就业参保、社保转移、断缴、居民医保、职工医保、五险一金、延迟退休、社保档位、社保补贴、4050补贴、社保优惠 etc.
